result.rationale: SOLCAP is KeyState's tax-credit syndication platform and a series of pooled LLCs, not a Generate/KeyState operating company. Generate owns/sponsors the solar assets; KeyState manages tax-equity capital. SEC filings classify the Generate-named vehicles as pooled funds and omit Generate as manager.

operatingResolution.censusTreatment: Tax-equity/fund interests are financing, not PortCo ownership.
